This individual will work closely with researchers to understand the molecular and biochemical pathways through which our new compounds work. This bench research position will support [Company name masked]'s goals to develop innovative treatments to improve the health of patients suffering from CNS disorders.

cond_0268.intro:
We are looking for a Research Associate II to join our team at [Company name masked].
This individual will coordinate with researchers to understand the molecular and biochemical pathways through which new compounds work. This bench research position will support [Company name masked]'s goals to develop treatments for patients with CNS disorders.

The Research Associate II will be responsible for, but not limited to:

This individual will own bench research to investigate the molecular and biochemical pathways through which new compounds work. This position will drive [Company name masked]'s goals to develop innovative treatments to improve the health of patients suffering from CNS disorders.
cond_0404.responsibilities:
The Research Associate II will be responsible for, but not limited to:
Executing general laboratory duties and setting up the bench for experiments, including maintaining laboratory equipment, stock solutions, placing and tracking animal orders, and maintaining supplies (e.g., commonly used reagents and glassware).
Running assays, troubleshooting, and proposing innovative solutions to address challenges.
Preparing technical reports, summaries, protocols, and accurate notebook documentation.
Owning room preparation for behavioral testing of preclinical models of mood disorders and cognitive impairment, running behavioral tests, scoring behavior, and analyzing data.
Directing mouse and rat handling, compound formulation, dosing (IP, PO, SC), and sample collection alongside scientists.
Maintaining good laboratory and safety practices, ensuring a clean and orderly environment.
Completing all company and job-related training as assigned within the required timelines.
Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Previous experience with safe handling of laboratory animals and expertise in tissue dissection.
Previous experience in behavioral testing in rodents.
Familiar with Good Laboratory Practices and trained in maintaining a safe working environment.
Detail-oriented, accountable and well organized in record documentation, multitasking and troubleshooting.
Ability to generate high quality data within the allocated time frame to meet the given objectives.
Must be able to perform all essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Experience in molecular biology (RNA extraction, RT-qPCR, western blot) and cell culture in a BSL2 environment.

Enthusiastic, responsible, reliable team player, with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Able to work independently on assigned tasks, as well as alongside others from a diverse background.

cond_0644.intro:
We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
This individual will work closely with researchers to understand the molecular and biochemical pathways through which our new compounds work. This bench research position will support [Company name masked]'s goals to develop innovative treatments to improve the health of patients suffering from CNS disorders. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with behavioral testing, molecular techniques, and preclinical research.
cond_0644.responsibilities:
